parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.tournament_id, m.division_id, m.match_no, m.status, m.event_count, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, m.scorer_user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, m.scorer_seen_at, NOW()) AS scorer_idle, sc.name AS scorer_name, viewer.id AS viewer_id, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_scorers sc WHERE sc.tournament_id = t.id AND sc.user_id = viewer.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_officials f JOIN tournament_officials_requests q ON q.tournament_id = f.tournament_id WHERE f.tournament_id = t.id AND f.user_id = viewer.id AND f.role = 'SCORER' AND q.status = 'CONFIRMED')) AS can_score, hm.name AS home_name, aw.name AS away_name FROM tournament_matches m JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN app_users sc ON sc.id = m.scorer_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries he ON he.id = m.home_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams hm ON hm.id = he.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries ae ON ae.id = m.away_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams aw ON aw.id = ae.team_id WHERE m.id = $2
